json.name: Claims By State
json.description: Calculated table derived from Policies and Claims.

json.viewLogic:
let
    Source = Snowflake.Databases("my-account.snowflakecomputing.com","COMPUTE_WH",[Implementation="2.0"]),
    Db = Source{[Name="INSURANCE_DB",Kind="Database"]}[Data],
    Sch = Db{[Name="ANALYTICS",Kind="Schema"]}[Data],
    Tbl = Sch{[Name="CLAIMS",Kind="Table"]}[Data]
in
    Tbl

fields.description: Amount paid out on the claim in USD.

VAR Losses = [Total Paid Losses]
RETURN DIVIDE(Losses, [Total Premium], 0) Measure-to-measure dependency: losses / premium.
